verdict.rationale: Blaxel's own docs describe two ways to schedule recurring work. Sandbox Schedules run a command on a recurring cron schedule, at a future datetime, or after a delay, with execution history per run. Jobs can also run batch AI workflows as scheduled or on-demand tasks. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and deeper documentation of how job schedules are configured (cron syntax, retries, workflow chaining).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Run a command inside a Blaxel sandbox on a recurring cron schedule, a future datetime, or after a delay, with execution history per run.
Run batch processing tasks for AI workflows on Blaxel as scheduled or on-demand jobs that scale automatically and run on serverless infrastructure.
